{{Quote|My scouts have identified a Flesh Raider command base in the mountains. It's protected by an energy shield.|[[Ranna Tao'Ven]]|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]]<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> of [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] had a '''command base''' in the [[Tythos Ridge]] mountains. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] of the nearby [[Kalikori village]] located the base through [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expeditions under the command of the village [[Scout Chief]] [[Moorint]], and told the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] of the base's location as part of their alliance against the hostile natives. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] gathered a strike force of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|eliminate the camp]], he sent his [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] to [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|take out]] the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting the base.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

Both assaults were successful, resulting in the destruction of both the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator and the base itself. During their attack, the Jedi discovered the location of many more Flesh Raider camps across the planet, and mobilized all available [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], Masters, and even some [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] to destroy the camps.<ref name="Dark Temptations">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Dark Temptations|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Flesh Raider command base is briefly mentioned in the [[BioWare]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "The Face of the Enemy". The player's master, Orgus Din, takes a strike team to eliminate the base while the player destroys the shield generator protecting the camp.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
